messages:
jane: Heads up — we're seeing a sharp 5xx spike across hosted inference after the hotfix deploy at 23:58 UTC. Errors are Gateway 502/504 and some timeouts. Support ticket #4241 just escalated from an enterprise customer.

miguel: looking now. Any recent config changes besides the hotfix image?

jane: The hotfix included a routing tag change to prefer `route:v2-hotfix` for a subset of traffic (canary ~12%). I suspect tag mismatch on the proxy side.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete: service=inference-api image=redwood/inference:hotfix-2026-03-16 canary=12%

vera: I see elevated 502s from the edge -> gateway within the last 3m. 95th latency up from 120ms to 2.8s. TTLs show a burst of backend connection resets.

alex: Repro steps from a curl hitting the edge (from us-east):
```
curl -v -H "x-route-tag: v2-hotfix" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate
```
Response: `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway` with logs showing upstream reset.

miguel: digging into gateway logs. Early sign: some nodes are refusing connections to the v2-hotfix pods with `connection reset by peer`. Could be a mismatched protocol or healthcheck failure.

support-bot: Customer #ACME (ticket #4241) reports intermittent 502 on batch generation, started ~23:59 UTC. Billing noted failed requests counted as errors. Please advise on mitigation.

sre-oncall: Immediate mitigation: can we remove the routing tag or reduce canary to 0? I don't want a full rollback yet until we confirm root cause.

jane: I'm going to flip the canary weight to 0 and remove the `route:v2-hotfix` header mapping in the routing config. Miguel, coordinate with deploy to apply the change.

deploy-bot: Adjusting canary weight: service=inference-api canary=0 -> update in progress

miguel: Pushing routing config patch now:
```
PATCH /configs/routing
- map route:v2-hotfix -> target=v2-hotfix
+ removed mapping for route:v2-hotfix
```
Applied to control-plane.

vera: After canary weight -> 0: 502 rate dropped 90% in 2m. Latency back to baseline by +4m. Edge errors almost gone.

alex: Confirmed ACME no longer reproducing 502s. They still saw billing hits for the failed attempts; support should coordinate credits.

support-bot: Noted. I'll open a billing review for ACME and tag finance. Reference ticket #4241.

jane: Thanks team. Next: postmortem items — (1) why did v2-hotfix reject connections? maybe healthcheck change or runtime crash under batch load, (2) routing config validation should prevent orphaned tags, (3) ensure failed requests in canary are not billed until confirmed success.

miguel: Quick root cause sniff: v2-hotfix enabled a stricter TLS client auth in the container that wasn't advertised to the proxy. Some gateway nodes tried plain HTTP and were reset. That matches `connection reset by peer`.

vera: Logs from pod v2-hotfix-7f88 show `tls: client auth required` at accept time. Healthchecks were green because they used a different probe path without TLS.

jane: Oof. So two mistakes: hotfix changed TLS behavior and routing tag applied without end-to-end compatibility check.

sre-oncall: Action items for rollback coordination: (a) leave canary=0 (done), (b) mark v2-hotfix as quarantined, (c) run compatibility tests before reapply. I will create a short runbook.

alex: I'll draft a customer-facing note for ACME and Sales (sales-eng), explain cause and mitigation, and propose a billing credit.

sales-eng: thanks — we need the incident summary and ETA for full resolution to communicate to the account team.

jane: I'll own the postmortem. Miguel and Vera please attach logs and the failing TLS config diff. SRE, please add the runbook link. Support, please keep ACME updated that we've mitigated and are offering credits.

support-bot: ACME notified: "We've reduced traffic to the hotfix variant and are investigating. We'll follow up with details and compensation." Ticket updated.

deploy-bot: Quarantine action: image redwood/inference:hotfix-2026-03-16 flagged `quarantined=true` in registry metadata.

miguel: Follow-up: we'll add a preflight check that validates protocol (tls/http) compatibility between proxy and new pod images when a routing tag is introduced.

jane: Closing thread once postmortem links are posted. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
